# VoilitAI

> Fast Voice OS agents that feel human. A reliable Vapi and Retell alternative for 24/7 answering, booking, qualification, CRM updates, and customer support.

- Site: https://voilitai.aventrexdigital.com
- Product app: https://app.voilitai.com/
- Contact: contact@voilitai.com
- Pricing: https://voilitai.aventrexdigital.com/pricing/

## Product

VoilitAI is a voice AI platform and Vapi / Retell alternative: visual flow builder, sub-600ms replies, real-time tools (calendar, CRM, payments, transfer), omni-channel voice/chat/SMS, SIP trunking, simulation QA, and SOC 2 / HIPAA-ready controls. Best for fast Voice OS agents and reliable 24/7 customer support.

Plans: Starter $49/month, Growth $199/month (14-day trial), Enterprise custom.

## For people

Never miss a call. Agents answer in seconds, sound natural, and hand off with context when a human should take over.
